_comment: sim-robust-couple-approach-v1: MERGE into the mission runtime-config for the bounded GPU proof (collect+couple under live_pose, cross-track + economy on, --stop-after couple). Both switches are default-off (absent => byte-identical). couple_cart_relative lands the couple STANDOFF on the MEASURED cart axis instead of the fixed map pose (authored couple_standoff yaw 0, but the pinned cart settles at a run-varying yaw -- coldlivefinal -1.6 deg, coupledock +19.2 deg -- so the fixed pose puts the base 8-27 deg / 25-470 mm off the real cart, a residual the fine-dock cannot null). The base navigates to standoff_from_cart(measured cart) (on-axis, base yaw = cart yaw, hitch held back standoff_offset_m), gates entry on the cart-relative cross-track + yaw, re-approaches a fresh cart-measured standoff when outside (bounded max_reapproach), and the fine-dock progress_cap replaces the blunt 30 s time cap: keep docking while the residual improves, up to progress_max_time_cap_s, failing fast at progress_patience_s on a limit cycle. PASS = couple reaches a physical latch (coupled + healthy). Named in the couple stage evidence (couple_arrival_mode) + the walkthrough caption. CPU proof: scripts/check_couple_approach.py; CPU tests: scripts/twin/tests/test_restock_couple_approach.py.
_fine_dock_note: Same crosstrack servo as PR 232, PLUS the progress-based cap (default off): progress_max_time_cap_s is the hard sim-clock bound, progress_patience_s fails a limit cycle fast, time_cap_s stays the legacy bound when progress_cap is absent. The fine_dock block below carries NO comment key (FineDockConfig rejects unknown keys).
